title: Casper and the Orbit
author: Ulyana Halloran
blurb: Jude Brightwater, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
